description.zh: 个人验证过的 DSH 插件组合：读图、视频理解、截图、余额与通知。picturereader 在 0.2.1 需 allow-version 豁免（实测可用）。
description.en: Personally verified DSH plugins: image reading, video understanding, screenshot, balance and notifications. picturereader needs a version exemption on 0.2.1 (works in testing).

description.zh: 像素扫描、OCR（macOS Vision / Windows OCR / RapidOCR）、裁剪、调色板与修图，让纯文本模型读图。0.2.1 需 allow-version 豁免（实测可用）。
description.en: Pixel scan, OCR (macOS Vision / Windows OCR / RapidOCR), crop, palette and edit. On 0.2.1 requires a version exemption (verified working).

description.zh: B站/本地视频 → ASR+场景+轨迹信息层 → 摘要/问答，默认 L0 全本地。
description.en: Bilibili/local video → ASR + scene + trajectory layer → summary/QA; local by default.

description.zh: 热键/相机按钮截图落盘，只传路径；Windows 走原生 PrintWindow。
description.en: Hotkey/camera capture to disk, passes paths only; native PrintWindow on Windows.

description.zh: 输入区旁常驻 DeepSeek 账户余额（15s 刷新）与本会话费用估算（官价/峰谷）。
description.en: Persistent DeepSeek account balance (15s refresh) plus per-session cost estimate (official pricing, peak/off-peak).

description.zh: 任务完成 / 提问或选项 / 出错三类系统通知（浏览器 Notification API），可分别开关。0.2.1 需 allow-version 豁免（实测可用）。
description.en: System notifications for task completion / questions / errors via the browser Notification API; separately toggleable. On 0.2.1 requires a version exemption (verified working).
